An insurance tool flags claims for manual review. It has an owner, a review procedure and accurate customer information. Testing has used only a supplier benchmark. There is no production monitoring or rollback process. Should the organisation approve production use, run an unrestricted pilot, or pause production and establish safeguards?

Pausing production and establishing safeguards is the best answer. A bounded pilot may then be appropriate, with suitable testing, monitoring, human review and rollback in place. Approving production would leave the stated gaps unresolved. Calling a deployment a pilot does not resolve them either. Manual referral can still cause harm through delay, bias or excessive reliance on automated recommendations. Assess the actual workflow before deciding how much control is needed.
